description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every old_string must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. Accepts one old_string/new_string pair or an edits array of multiple replacements applied atomically in one call.
name: edit_file

edits.description: Multiple replacements applied atomically. Each entry has old_string and new_string; every old_string must match a unique, non-overlapping region. Use this or old_string/new_string, not both

old_string.description: The exact text to search for (must be unique). Use this or edits, not both

path.description: Absolute path to the file to edit
